summary: Five Guys and Jack in the Box use Altametrics workforce scheduling/back-office software to manage labor scheduling and food costs. (Scope note: Sourced from the vendor's own marketing pages citing these brands; no independent trade-press confirmation of contract scope found.)

Altametrics is an enterprise back-office software suite for restaurant chains covering inventory control, workforce management, employee scheduling, and loss prevention, with AI-powered demand-based scheduling.
